skill.name: cold-email-list-quality
skill.description: Review CSV or JSONL prospect lists using a six-axis quality rubric. Identify duplicates, targeting mismatches, stale signals, and address concerns before outreach.
skill.summary: Assess prospect list quality and recommend cleanup using documented rules; the deterministic scoring script is not included.
skill.author: cmj-hub

content.value_statement: Duplicates, stale signals, and targeting mismatches waste outreach capacity. This skill guides CSV or JSONL list reviews with a weighted rubric, removal reasons, and prioritized cleanup recommendations.
actual_capabilities: Guides assistant-led scoring from 0 to 100 across six weighted quality axes.
Defines duplicate checks for email and LinkedIn URLs, with manual review for matching person-company records.
Compares roles and inferred company stages with available ideal customer profile configuration.
Grades signal age and flags address-shape issues, free-email domains, role accounts, and plus-address warnings.
Checks exclusion criteria and reports removal reasons with prioritized fixes.
Specifies cleaned and removed CSV outputs and send-volume recommendations using supplied warm-up status.
limitations: The scoring script is not shipped; results and file creation depend on assistant execution rather than an included deterministic program.
Address heuristics cannot confirm mailbox existence or deliverability; the skill does not send email.
Targeting and freshness checks depend on complete input fields, current configuration, and inferred company-stage information.
No external verification or enrichment service is included; enrichment must already be present in supplied rows.

use_cases.title: Prepare a New Prospect List
use_cases.description: Review an imported CSV or JSONL list for duplicates, address concerns, and records outside campaign requirements.

use_cases.title: Refresh Weekly Outreach Data
use_cases.description: Review signal age, role fit, exclusions, and company stage before refreshing the weekly campaign list.

use_cases.title: Audit ICP Alignment
use_cases.description: Compare supplied prospects with ideal customer profile rules and prioritize changes to targeting or list sourcing.

prompt_templates.title: Score My List
prompt_templates.prompt: Review prospects.csv using the documented quality rubric. Report axis scores, removal candidates, and top fixes. State missing fields and avoid assuming mailbox deliverability.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of a prepared prospect file.

prompt_templates.title: Find Duplicate Records
prompt_templates.prompt: Review prospects.csv for duplicate emails, LinkedIn URLs, and person-company matches. Keep the oldest email record and newest LinkedIn signal. Flag near-duplicates for review.
prompt_templates.scenario: Cleaning an existing list before enrichment or outreach.

prompt_templates.title: Apply ICP Rules
prompt_templates.prompt: Score prospects.csv against brand-config.json. Check roles, exclusions, signal dates, address heuristics, and inferred company stages. Explain assumptions and separate warnings from removal recommendations.
prompt_templates.scenario: Applying a configured ICP to a campaign list.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Campaign List
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit prospects.jsonl using brand-config.json and supplied warm-up status. Report scores, cleanup priorities, and send-volume arithmetic. Preserve the original. Write reviewed cleaned and removed CSV files.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced quality review before importing into an outreach platform.

output_examples.input: Illustrative review: a list includes duplicate emails, signals older than 30 days, and prospects outside configured role targets.
output: Illustrative score: 72/100. Deduplication: 16/20; role fit: 18/25; freshness: 10/20; address heuristics: 12/15; exclusions: 8/10; company stage: 8/10.
Keep the oldest record for each duplicate email. Review near-duplicates manually.
Refresh stale signals and review prospects outside role targets before import. Mailbox deliverability remains unverified.

output_examples.input: Illustrative review: ICP rules target revenue leaders at Series A or Series B companies; rows include role accounts and plus-addresses.
output: Flag role-account addresses for removal under the documented B2B heuristic.
Warn on plus-addresses without claiming they are invalid mailboxes.
Compare inferred funding stages and revenue roles with the configured targets. Report uncertain company stages for review.

best_practices: Provide current ICP configuration, dated signals, and complete prospect fields; identify missing information before accepting scores.
Preserve the original list and review removal reasons and output destinations before writing cleaned files.
Confirm mailbox deliverability separately and refresh stale signals before campaign import.
anti_patterns: Treating a high quality score as proof of deliverability or permission to contact prospects.
Executing the documented Python example when the referenced scoring script is absent.
Automatically deleting near-duplicates or treating plus-address warnings as proof of invalid mailboxes.

faq.question: Which file formats are supported?
faq.answer: The instructions cover CSV and JSONL. Email is the minimum field; roles, companies, signals, dates, and LinkedIn URLs enable more checks.

faq.question: What does the score measure?
faq.answer: Weights are deduplication 20, role fit 25, freshness 20, address heuristics 15, exclusions 10, and company stage 10.

faq.question: Does this skill verify email deliverability?
faq.answer: No. It checks address shape, domain categories, role accounts, and plus-address patterns. It does not confirm mailbox existence.

faq.question: Can it use my ICP rules?
faq.answer: Yes. Supplied brand configuration provides role targets, exclusions, segment information, and signal anchors. Missing fields limit targeting confidence.

faq.question: Is the scoring script included?
faq.answer: No. The release note defers the deterministic script to a future release. Current scoring follows instructions interpreted by the assistant.

faq.question: What outputs should I expect?
faq.answer: Expect scores, removal reasons, and prioritized fixes. The workflow specifies cleaned and removed CSV files for review; it does not send messages.
